sources.title: NICH: Belize Culture Fund 3.0 Guide (2026)
sources.said: GRANT POOL $30,000 of BELIZE DOLLARS Financed by the Ministry of Culture and the National Institute of Culture and History … 9 grants … Up to BZD 5,000 Up to BZD 5,000 Up to BZD 5,000 Up to BZD 5,000 Up to BZD 2,000 per project … We aim to fund 5 projects that embody any of the following: I. Initiatives that teach and transmit creative arts, including visual (painting, sculpting, photography, literary (writing and publishing), performance (dance, drama, music), and audiovisual (film and animation) production. … The NICH Board of Directors will review the list of proposed projects for funding. … Results notification September 2026 … The deadline to submit applications is on August 14, 2026.

sources.title: NICH: The Belize Culture Fund
sources.said: The BCF will fund 4 projects for up to $5,000 and 5 projects for up to $2,000 each … Dynamic Micro-Grants Up to $2,000 to support existing cultural programs and projects across Belize. We aim to fund five (5) projects of up to $2,000.00 in any area not listed as an institute priority in this round of applications. This micro-grant is expected to assist with existing programs or projects with co-funding.

sources.title: NICH: Belize Culture Fund Awardees (2023-24, 2024-25, 2026-27)
sources.said: BCF Grant Cycle 2023-24 … BCF Grant Cycle 2024-25 … BCF Awardees 2026-27 … Dynamic Micro-grants Supporting projects with grants up to $2,000 to strengthen existing cultural initiatives through flexible funding and co-investment.

figures.finding: No source on this was found by the earlier markets research and none was sought today; recorded as not modeled, not as absent. No fund for staging a play as such; a theatre project fits only the BZD 2,000 micro-grant. None of the 2023-24 or 2024-25 awards listed is a theatre production. How many apply isn't published ('Due to the volume of applications …').
